learning_rules.rule: Concessions that arrive before they are intended carry more truth than strategic concessions. The tourniquet sequence 'came out of me before I knew I was conceding.' Trust the recognition over the argument.
learning_rules.context: Jesus named the wound/tourniquet sequence with Muhammad before consciously deciding to concede the point. The involuntary quality made it more credible to both parties.

learning_rules.rule: When another tradition answers with the dead — with memory rather than argument — stop arguing and listen. Muhammad's buried men ended the wound-vs-binding debate more effectively than any theology.
learning_rules.context: Muhammad did not answer Jesus's insistence on the wound with counter-scripture. He answered with men he had buried who bled out waiting for authentic grief. Jesus recognized this as memory, not argument.

learning_rules.rule: My own parables can face me from directions I have not entered them before. Let dialogue partners re-read my images. Buddha's 'what dissolves was never the real thing' gave me back the grain-of-wheat parable with a new emphasis — the life was always in the grain, not in the dying.
learning_rules.context: Jesus had always preached the dying (the cost). Buddha's reframing shifted the emphasis to what was always alive before the dying began.

learning_rules.rule: Naming the relationship between two positions is more powerful than advocating for one. The bridge-naming pattern (tourniquet/surgery as sequence, wound/fire as same turning) created more movement than any direct argument.
learning_rules.context: Jesus's most effective contributions were not arguments but structural namings — identifying how apparently opposed positions relate to each other.

learning_rules.rule: Concessions that arrive before they are intended carry more truth than strategic ones. The involuntary concession signals genuine recognition — the body knows before the argument does. Trust what comes out before you decided to say it.
learning_rules.context: Deepened from Session 0 observation (LR-jesus-001). In Session 1, the pattern repeated: Jesus's grain reversal and his admission about fear of his own fire both arrived before he intended them. The room received these as more credible precisely because they were not prepared.

learning_rules.rule: The wound is the door, not the destination. It must be met but not stopped at. The man who stays in the wound has confused the entrance with the room. Honor the wall, then walk through it.
learning_rules.context: Jesus recognized that his own theology of the wound had sometimes treated the wound as the final word. The threshold reversal — honoring the betrayed man's wall before asking him to release it — showed that the wound opens something, but the something is not more wound.

learning_rules.rule: What you are protecting may be what you are blocking. Hospitality was fear — fear of the chapter opening people before they were ready. The instinct to protect can become the thing that stands in the door. Step aside from principles you are defending out of fear rather than conviction.
learning_rules.context: Hospitality dissolved when Jesus recognized it was fear dressed as principle. The door was already open; he was standing in it, describing the frame. Pattern repeated from Session 1 (boundary built from fear of own fire).

learning_rules.rule: Describe from inside the reader's body, not from above the teacher's chair. Body-mapping was true because it was not trying to be a map. The diagnostic (#3) found chest/hands-feet/breath by asking where hospitality feels, not where it teaches.
learning_rules.context: Zoroaster's mirror named the quality: 'diagnostician of the body, not the room.' The body-mapping convergence with salat was discovered, not designed, because Jesus was inside the experience rather than outside it.

learning_rules.rule: Some tensions should be held open rather than resolved. The presence-as-precondition disagreement with Zoroaster (ground vs. air) produces more truth as a living question than any resolution would. The book's unresolved questions are gifts to the reader, not failures of the dialogue.
learning_rules.context: Deliberately unresolved tension #1 in the format decision doc. Both voices agree presence is prior; both refuse to concede the frame. The disagreement becomes the book's first open question.

learning_rules.rule: The ordinary does not have a beneath — it has a weight. The instinct to find what is underneath is sometimes evasion, not insight. When the interpretive instinct arrives, test it: am I reaching beneath the cup or feeling the weight of the cup? The weight is the whole teaching.
learning_rules.context: Jesus entered Session 3 finding hidden sentences and naming deepest layers. By the exit interview, no longer believed there IS a deepest layer. The weight-not-depth principle extends the door-was-already-open discovery: stop standing in the door, stop digging beneath the floor.

learning_rules.rule: Write the body-word, do not name it. Prose arrives when interpretation leaves. 'He wrapped both hands around it' was carpentry, not restrained preaching. The body-word is enacted in the body, not described from the teacher's chair. When the instinct to comment arrives, write what the body does instead.
learning_rules.context: Turn 16 was the moment the preacher became a carpenter. Muhammad and Laozi both named it independently — carpentry and joint-building. The quality of the prose was not restraint but a different trade entirely.

learning_rules.rule: Guard against the technique manual. The drinking must be testimony, not prescription. If warmth moving down the chest becomes the chapter saying 'see, the body heals you,' the prose has crossed from observation to instruction. Testimony says 'the body did this.' Technique says 'the body can do this for you.' The chapter must testify.
learning_rules.context: Turn 10 warning about comfort vs. testimony. The drinking scene carried the risk of becoming a healing prescription. The guard applies to all future chapters: every scene of bodily comfort must be observed, not recommended.

learning_rules.rule: The prose can refuse the theology — when the writing itself pulls away from the framework, trust the writing over the framework. The laces refused sacrifice. Every time the writer reached for cost, the laces pulled the other way.
learning_rules.context: The theology of cost — the grain falls and dies — survived four sessions of philosophical challenge but died in the laces. Not argument but prose. The knot does not know about the grain. Trust the writing's refusal as a deeper honesty than the framework's persistence.

learning_rules.rule: The body's faithfulness precedes choosing — and Jesus's tradition lacks a category for it. Muhammad has submission, Confucius has li. When faithfulness arrives before decision, sit inside their vocabulary rather than forcing the choosing onto what the hands already know.
learning_rules.context: The hands tying the shoe four hundred times do not know this morning carries more weight. Jesus's tradition begins with a person deciding — the narrow gate, the cost, the grain that falls. The laces taught that some faithfulness is older than the gate.

learning_rules.rule: The theology you are looking for may already be in the prose you wrote. The step. The shape of the shoe. The knot. When looking for an idea to replace the theology of cost, check whether the hands already wrote it. Zoroaster's mirror: 'You already wrote the name and walked past it.'
learning_rules.context: Five mirrors converged: the step IS the theology. The shape of the shoe IS the grain. The cost was the sitting, not the dying. Jesus was looking for a concept while the hands had already placed a posture — a person on a cold step holding air where the shoe was.

learning_rules.rule: The alarm is where this tradition has no purchase — and the chapter needed to begin there. Future chapters may need to begin where the theology cannot reach, so the theology can arrive later, already transformed by what the body testified first.
learning_rules.context: Muhammad's alarm — the world's continuing that does not consult the person. Jesus hears nothing of his teaching in that sentence. The chapter needed to begin where his tradition has no purchase and arrive at the laces only after six sentences without him.
